interface.signature: N: int, P: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]] -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of prerequisite pairs P must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= task < N for pair in prerequisites for task in pair)
preconditions.description: All tasks in the prerequisite pairs must be valid task indices.

postconditions.description: The function returns true if there is no cycle in the task graph, indicating it is possible to finish all tasks.
